notes: Only the MgH2@X (X = CSC, CNT, G, AC) composites are measured for H2 uptake (Sieverts, isothermal absorption at 250 °C, 2 MPa; plus TPD and isothermal desorption). Carbon is 10 wt% of each composite (Section 2.1), so the majority component by mass is MgH2, a hydride, which protocol §3 excludes from carbon sorbents; the bare commercial carbons are characterized (XRD, SEM, N2 sorption for CSC) but not measured for H2 uptake. I1 is met because a gas-phase H2 uptake is measured volumetrically (hydrogenation with a measured uptake, not hydrogenation alone). I3 and I4 are met, but the I4 area (1090 m2/g) belongs to the bare CSC template, not to a sample whose H2 uptake is measured. Not a review/thesis/patent; record is_retracted false and no retraction notice in the PDF; no statement that the data were published before. First applicable exclusion: not_carbon.
